minimum_fit_samples.rationale: An affine fit needs at least three ordered observations so a residual check is meaningful.

outlier_mad_scale.rationale: Iterative least-squares rejection keeps samples within four MADs of the current residual centre.

minimum_mad_ns.rationale: Do not treat sub-microsecond numerical/serialization variation as a resolvable outlier scale.

fit_max_iterations.rationale: Bound robust-fit work while allowing the inlier mask to settle.

step_window_samples.rationale: Compare five observations on each side of a candidate residual discontinuity.

step_threshold_ns.rationale: A five-millisecond residual jump is reported as a possible transport/clock step; it is not a robot acceptance limit.

maximum_step_segments.rationale: Bound recursive discontinuity splitting on malformed or highly discontinuous input.

max_discontinuities.rationale: Any detected reversal or residual step makes continuity diagnostics FAIL; this is not a hardware acceptance budget.
